d: Nvidia reinstates co-founder Jensen Huang as CEO in a stunning reversal, just 11 days after he resigned amid revelations of multiple alleged extramarital affairs, including one involving a Chinese businesswoman suspected by US intelligence of spying for Beijing. The board had initially rejected his return before reversing course following pressure from President Donald Trump, who personally lobbied directors and called Huang a “national treasure”. Nvidia says government assurances helped establish that his return poses no national security risk. The decision sends Nvidia shares soaring but…
